property_summary: For any bytes4 interfaceId, the original supportsInterface returns true if interfaceId matches IERC1155 OR IERC1155MetadataURI OR IERC165; the mutant uses AND, so it returns false when interfaceId matches only one of IERC1155 or IERC1155MetadataURI.
change_summary: Replace the final OR with AND (use &&)
